leader.title: President of the Council of Ministers

election._note: By law no later than 22 December 2027; Wikipedia 'Next Italian general election'. Rosatellum's ~61% PR / ~37% single-member split reduced to 'parallel' — see docs/electoral-systems.md.

formation._note: PM appointed by the President of the Republic, then must win a confidence vote in both chambers. No confidence is simple -- no successor required. Art. 94 of the Constitution.
